description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.9, §5.13, decision 26): the woodfolk's oath, one of the three powers' for quest.world_main's oaths stage. It starts at stage 4. Meet Sedge, Hollowmere's elder (50; among the huts on the pond's south shore for a giant of stage 4, on the green for a bigger one), then lift the blight of the Troll Matriarch one of two ways, each open as a first oath at stage 4: slay her in the Troll Den (750 at Sedge's: the woodfolk's feast, 2 attribute points); or drive her out - burn the den's three brood nests (3 x 50: a smashed brazier beside a nest, a burning troll or whelp hurled into one), open the den's back wall (the woodfolk pull it down 20 s after the third nest burns, a giant of stage 5 heaves it at once, and Stormborn's bargain with Sedge has them open it at once) and bring her below 60 % so she flees through it (600 at Sedge's; her scattered brood then roams the Greywood as a troll pack). Every resolution pays the oath's reward (loot.oath_reward: 1 titan iron, 2 iron), lifts the XP to level 9, makes the woodfolk allies and lights Hollowmere's lanterns. Worst path 800 XP, best 800.

stages.objective: Meet Sedge, the woodfolk's elder, at Hollowmere
Lift the blight: slay the Troll Matriarch, or burn her nests and drive her from the den
stages.waiting_text: Sedge asks you to rid the Greywood of the Troll Matriarch: slay her, or burn her three brood nests, see the den's back wall opened and drive her out through it.
The Matriarch is gone from the den. Sedge waits at Hollowmere to swear the woodfolk's oath.
